description: This file defines data structures, constants, and methods for handling autocomplete commands in the Mattermost server, including argument types, command data, validation, URL handling, and JSON unmarshalling.

classes.name: AutocompleteData
classes.description: Represents slash command autocomplete information, including trigger, arguments, subcommands, and related methods.

classes.name: AutocompleteArg
classes.description: Represents an argument of a command, including its name, help text, type, requirement status, and data.

classes.name: AutocompleteTextArg
classes.description: Describes text input argument details such as hint and regex pattern.

classes.name: AutocompleteListItem
classes.description: Represents an item in a static list argument, including item value, hint, and help text.

classes.name: AutocompleteStaticListArg
classes.description: Contains possible arguments for static list arguments.

classes.name: AutocompleteDynamicListArg
classes.description: Contains URL for fetching dynamic list arguments.

classes.name: AutocompleteSuggestion
classes.description: Describes a suggestion item sent to the front-end, including completion, suggestion, hint, description, and icon data.

methods.name: NewAutocompleteData
methods.description: Creates a new AutocompleteData instance with specified trigger, hint, and help text.

methods.name: AddCommand
methods.description: Adds a subcommand to the AutocompleteData.

methods.name: AddTextArgument
methods.description: Adds a positional text argument to the command.

methods.name: AddNamedTextArgument
methods.description: Adds a named text argument to the command.

methods.name: AddStaticListArgument
methods.description: Adds a positional static list argument.

methods.name: AddNamedStaticListArgument
methods.description: Adds a named static list argument.

methods.name: AddDynamicListArgument
methods.description: Adds a positional dynamic list argument.

methods.name: AddNamedDynamicListArgument
methods.description: Adds a named dynamic list argument.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two AutocompleteData instances are equivalent.

methods.name: UpdateRelativeURLsForPluginCommands
methods.description: Updates relative URLs in dynamic list arguments based on a base URL.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the AutocompleteData structure for correctness.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two AutocompleteArg instances are equivalent.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON unmarshalling for AutocompleteArg, parsing JSON into the appropriate argument type and data.
